Name: Time Control
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#f6b26b][b][size=6]Time Control[/size][/b][/color][/center]
[center][size=5]Time skip, stamina regen, time speed control, pause, menu auto-pause, multiplayer voting, per-minute clock[/size][/center]
[line]

[b][size=5]Time Skip[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Open a time picker menu while sitting on furniture to select a target time.[/*]
[*]Time passes smoothly at a configurable rate, forward or backward, instead of jumping straight to the target.[/*]
[*]Option to allow skipping to past times on the same day (default: off).[/*]
[*]Restrict skip access to host only or allow any player (default: any). Host settings are enforced on all clients.[/*]
[*]Stamina regen during a skip scales with game time passed, so a 6-hour skip fills stamina regardless of how fast the skip runs.[/*]
[*]Regen multiplier is synced to all players so everyone recovers stamina at the correct rate during the skip.[/*]
[*]Show a one-time notification with the skip hotkey when sitting down.[/*]
[*]Skip broadcasts a notification to all players when finished.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Sit Energy Regen[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Recover stamina per second while sitting on furniture.[/*]
[*]Configurable base energy rate per second.[/*]
[*]Option to ignore global time speed when calculating regen rate.[/*]
[*]Option to continue regenerating while time is frozen.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Time Speed[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Adjust global time speed from 0.1x to 10x. 1.0 is normal, 2.0 is twice as fast, 0.5 is half speed.[/*]
[*]Tick interval scales inversely with speed setting.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Time Freeze[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pause Requirement[/b] - Any: pauses when any player needs it. All: pauses only when all players need it. Host: pauses only when host needs it.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Pause in Menus[/b] - When enabled, time pauses only when all players are in menus, fishing, or any action that would stop time in single player. When disabled, menus never pause time (default: on).[/*]
[*][b]Lock Monsters in Place[/b] - Monsters are frozen in place and cannot deal damage while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Monster Invincibility[/b] - Monsters cannot lose health while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Pause Machine Timers[/b] - Machines and crafting stop processing while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Pause Buff Timers[/b] - Food, drink, and other buff durations do not expire while time is paused.[/*]
[*][b]Disable Damage While Paused[/b] - Player health is locked. Damage cannot be taken while paused.[/*]
[*][b]Pause During Events[/b] - Pauses time while any player is in a cutscene or event.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Multiplayer[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Vote to pause or unpause time. Vote counts and player names are broadcast as chat messages.[/*]
[*]Vote state and time skip regen multiplier sync from host to all clients.[/*]
[*]Peer connect detection warns on version mismatch or missing mod.[/*]
[*]Public API for other mods to query vote state, player count, and tracked player IDs. [u]Used in my other mod:[/u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48739]Party Info[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Clock Display[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Updates the clock display every in-game minute instead of every 10 minutes.[/*]
[*]Pause indicator: shows an X icon on the clock when time is frozen.[/*]
[/list]
[spoiler][b][size=5]API[/size][/b]
Time Control registers a SMAPI API under the mod ID [font=Consolas]yousv.TimeControl[/font]. Other mods can access it via [font=Consolas]IModRegistry.GetApi[/font].
[list]
[*][b]HasPlayerVotedToPause(long farmerId)[/b] - Returns whether the given player has toggled their pause vote on.[/*]
[*][b]VoteCount[/b] - Number of players currently with yes votes.[/*]
[*][b]TotalPlayers[/b] - Total number of tracked players.[/*]
[*][b]GetTrackedPlayerIds()[/b] - All tracked player unique IDs.[/*]
[/list]Usage example:
[code]
var api = helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<ITimeControlApi>("yousv.TimeControl");
if (api != null)
{
bool voted = api.HasPlayerVotedToPause(someFarmerId);
int paused = api.VoteCount;
}[/code]The API is read-only. External mods can read vote state but cannot send messages or modify Time Control's internal state.[/spoiler]

[center][b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b][/center]
Configure in-game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], or edit the config.json file directly.
[line]

[center][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[/list]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[line]

[center][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
